Subdomain.title: Tenant Subdomain
Subdomain.description: The 28-character tenant subdomain from your Marketing Cloud Installed Package (e.g. mc563885gzs27c5t9-63k636ttgm). Every base URI is tenant-specific and is derived from it: {Subdomain}.auth.marketingcloudapis.com/v2/token. The REST and SOAP base URIs are then taken from that token response (rest_instance_url / soap_instance_url) and are never hardcoded.

ClientID.title: Client ID
ClientID.description: The client_id of a Marketing Cloud Installed Package API Integration component (Server-to-Server). An Installed Package is required; there is no username/password path for this connector.

ClientSecret.title: Client Secret
ClientSecret.description: The client_secret of the same Installed Package API Integration component.

AccountID.title: Business Unit MID (optional)
AccountID.description: Optional account_id (MID) selecting the business unit the token should act on. Omit to use the Installed Package's default business unit. Sent as account_id on the v2/token request.

Scope.title: Scope (optional)
Scope.description: Optional space-delimited OAuth scope list narrowing the token's permissions to a subset of those granted to the Installed Package. Omit to receive every scope the package allows.
